entries.name: Dean River Classified Waters
entries.regs_verbatim: Dean River Classified Waters. All anglers are required to buy a Classified Waters Licence to fish the classified portions of the Dean River. There are no limits on the number of days which a Canadian resident may fish the classified sections of the Dean River. A Non-Resident Alien is allowed only one Classified Waters Licence for the Dean River, and may only fish one classified section of the Dean River for a maximum of 8 consecutive days per year regardless of whether guided or unguided. A non-guided Non-Resident Alien wishing to fish the Class I - Main Section of the Dean River, from Crag Creek to signs 500 m upstream the canyon, must enter an annual limited entry draw held each spring.

rules.verbatim: All anglers are required to buy a Classified Waters Licence to fish the classified portions of the Dean River.
rules.review_reason: BOUND — named water. Water-scoped to the Dean River.

rules.verbatim: There are no limits on the number of days which a Canadian resident may fish the classified sections of the Dean River.
rules.review_reason: BOUND — named water. Water-scoped to the Dean River, and angler-class scoped: Canadian residents have NO day limit, which is the counterpart to the non-resident-alien restriction in r3.

rules.verbatim: A non-guided Non-Resident Alien wishing to fish the Class I - Main Section of the Dean River, from Crag Creek to signs 500 m upstream the canyon, must enter an annual limited entry draw held each spring.
rules.extent_text: Dean River Class I Main Section, Crag Creek to signs 500 m above the canyon
rules.review_reason: BOUND — named water. A rationing mechanism, not a restriction on water: allocation=limited_entry_draw.
